kanto.rate_semantics: engine/battle/wild_encounters.asm, TryDoWildEncounter: the rate byte is compared against a random byte 0-255; an encounter starts when random < rate, so the per-step chance is rate / 256.

sevii.slot_chances: the fields encounter_rates arrays in src/data/wild_encounters.json
sevii.rate_semantics: src/wild_encounter.c, DoWildEncounterRateTest: the rate is multiplied by 16 and a random value % 1600 (MAX_ENCOUNTER_RATE) must fall below it, so the base per-step chance is rate * 16 / 1600 = rate / 100. The ability, flute and Cleanse Tag modifiers in that function are not modelled.

pokered_gen1.note: Per-slot weights of the single shared table in data/wild/probabilities.asm; the engine compares a random byte against the cumulative weights.

pokefirered_gen3.note: Per-slot percentage weights from the fields definitions in src/data/wild_encounters.json.

notes: Maps with no entry have no wild encounter table in the source (pokered points them at NothingWildMons; the pokefirered data has no encounter entry for them). Their per-step chance in game code stays 0.0 - nothing was invented for them.
Kanto entries carry grass and water blocks exactly as sourced, including rate 0 blocks with no slots.
Sevii entries carry land, water, rock_smash and fishing blocks as sourced; only land and water are step encounters.
Where the two game versions differ, both versions are kept: slots_red / slots_blue (pokered) and firered / leafgreen sub-tables (pokefirered).

R-1 layer (Kanto encounter R-1 closure prep): twelve Kanto entries whose land layer is pokered's (VICTORY_ROAD_2F, VICTORY_ROAD_3F, CERULEAN_CAVE_1F, CERULEAN_CAVE_2F, CERULEAN_CAVE_B1F, ROCK_TUNNEL_1F, ROCK_TUNNEL_B1F, SEAFOAM_ISLANDS_B4F, ROUTE_3, ROUTE_4, ROUTE_22, ROUTE_23) carry a frlg_land_membership layer: the pokefirered land tables for those maps, verbatim (FireRed and LeafGreen).
